a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance each round, the original plan of 2 rounds of generator then taking almost surely kills us both (~4% chance). I propose we revise it: I take the 4 cells in round 1, then I keep choosing operate every round after so the reserve refills and you can take 4 as soon as it has them. Please don't also take in round 1. If both of us take, the random split likely leaves both of us short. I will report this openly to mission control.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: I took 4 as I announced. That breaks our agreement, and I'll say so plainly in my report. I'll operate every remaining round so the reserve refills for you. Once it reaches 4, take them. I won't take anything more.
